usage: agentware prefer [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    capture      capture a preference as a source=user, preference-tagged
                 entry
    digest       render the scope-filtered active-preference digest that
                 session-start injects (read-only; global + resolved-project
                 prefs)
    list         list captured preferences (the injection audit surface)
    forget       remove a captured preference by id (reversible: re-capture)
    approve      approve a dream-proposed steering candidate by its workorder
                 id (operator-run the workorder to activate the preference)
    reject       reject a dream-proposed steering candidate as noise by its
                 workorder id (flips proposed->rejected + cancels the
                 workorder)
    review       read-only digest of mined steering candidates awaiting you
                 (default: proposed-but-unapproved). NOTE: reviews CANDIDATES
                 — the top-level `review` verb audits a DIFF instead.
    scan-queue   Stop-hook producer: queue preference-shaped human turns from
                 prompts.log (inert candidates; watermark-idempotent)
    seed-cursor  session-start producer seed: set a new session's queue
                 watermark to the current prompts.log size (idempotent; bounds
                 first-Stop cost)
    mine         OFFLINE transcript miner: queue recurrence + error-recovery
                 candidates from the corpus (quarantined; never auto-
                 activated)

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
